service_account.title: Service account key
service_account.description: JSON key of a service account that can read Cloud Monitoring metrics.

project_id.title: Project ID
project_id.description: ID of the project whose metrics are read. Defaults to the service account's project.

client_email.title: Service account identity
client_email.description: Email address of the service account.

custom_reports.title: Custom reports
custom_reports.description: Custom reports, one per line, each written as a report name:metric type|resource type:column list.
